meta.title: Per-line times on an awarded round are refused
gaps: The available library case verifies refusal because the round is non-staggered; it does not specifically assert that the awarded state causes the refusal.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the trade staggered time request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Request not found”, and never with a server error.
